name: Dr. Seinde Oladapo Fadeni
heroSubtitle: Entrepreneur, Founder & CEO with more than 30 years of corporate leadership — shaping high-impact enterprise across Nigeria's Aviation, Energy and Maritime sectors.
executiveProfile: Dr. Seinde Oladapo Fadeni is a Nigerian entrepreneur, investor and corporate leader with more than three decades of experience building, scaling and providing strategic leadership across the energy, aviation and maritime sectors. He founded GMT Energy Resources in 2007 and grew it into a $700 million provider of engineering and marine logistics services to Nigeria's oil & gas sector.

His leadership spans both privately held enterprise and major corporate institutions — from board chairmanships at NAHCO PLC and Forte Upstream Services, to executive leadership of Godsmart Nig Ltd, to international board experience with Samsung Heavy Industries Nigeria on one of Nigeria's largest offshore energy developments.

He is now focused on building enduring enterprises and identifying strategic investment opportunities capable of competing at scale — within Nigeria, across Africa, and in partnership with international markets.

strategicValueDrivers.title: Entrepreneurial Founder
strategicValueDrivers.desc: Founded GMT Energy Resources Limited in 2007 and built it from the ground up into a $700 million integrated Offshore Engineering, Procurement and Installation (EPIC) and marine logistics company serving Nigeria's oil & gas sector, with offices in Lagos and Port Harcourt.

strategicValueDrivers.title: Turnaround & Governance Leadership
strategicValueDrivers.desc: As Chairman of NAHCO PLC, secured multi-year contract renewals with major airlines at Lagos and Abuja airports and led an operational transformation that improved turnaround times. As Chief Executive Officer of Godsmart Nig Ltd, delivered a 44% increase in revenue.

strategicValueDrivers.title: Capital & M&A Judgment
strategicValueDrivers.desc: Provided strategic M&A advisory as a board member of Consolidated Hallmark Holdings Plc (Dec 2024 – Dec 2025), including identifying and evaluating acquisition opportunities at board level.

strategicValueDrivers.title: Cross-Sector, International Fluency
strategicValueDrivers.desc: Board-level experience spanning aviation, energy and maritime sectors, including service on the board of Samsung Heavy Industries Nigeria during the integration of six topside modules for the EGINA FPSO — one of Nigeria's largest offshore energy developments.

sectorFootprint.title: Upstream Investments
sectorFootprint.detail: Provided strategic leadership in repositioning the company from core operations into a diversified investment and project-development firm.

sectorFootprint.title: Aviation Services

sectorFootprint.title: Marine Infrastructure
sectorFootprint.detail: Board-level involvement in the Nigerian industrial ecosystem surrounding the EGINA FPSO development, guiding the integration project and ensuring on-time delivery of six complex topside modules.

sectorFootprint.title: Offshore Energy

sectorFootprint.title: Ground Handling Services
